title: Sonny Styles has met with the Jets, plans to visit the Cowboys, Commanders and Bengals

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sonny Styles has met with the Jets, plans to visit the Cowboys, Commanders and Bengals
sources.description: Linebacker Sonny Styles is one of the top prospects in this year's draft class and he's starting to make the rounds with teams that could make him a first-round pick next month.
